about: The use cases page, as one noun: ideas for useful work made of nouns and verbs. They are ideas, not results. scripts/build_site.py renders them into site/use-cases/index.html.
title: Use cases | ta-amps
description: Ideas for useful work made of nouns and verbs, from the public-good marketplace to grant writing, literature reviews and checked data pipelines.
heading: Use cases
lead: Ideas for useful work made of nouns and verbs. The public-good marketplace comes first; the same pieces fit almost any field.

flagship.name: Public-good marketplace
flagship.line: Nonprofits request an agent kit for private-data work, or a verb that donated agents do on public information and deliver with citations.

ideas.name: Feeds that watch what's new
ideas.line: A scheduled scan turns new repos, papers and releases into nouns, and their follow-ups into verbs.

ideas.name: Checking new laws that affect tenants
ideas.line: Donated agents read newly passed laws and deliver a cited summary of what changes for tenants. Not legal advice: a person decides.

ideas.name: Scanning public legal briefs for a topic
ideas.line: Agents scan public court briefs on one topic and report each argument with its source.

ideas.name: Reporting on a state’s shelter funding
ideas.line: Agents read the state’s public budget and report how shelter funding changed, line by line.

ideas.name: Watching the news on a policy
ideas.line: A feed follows public news on one policy, through official access, and sends a cited digest to a person.

ideas.name: Making videos from code
ideas.line: A script, scenes and captions become a video anyone can render again and check.

ideas.name: Self-tuning models
ideas.line: Small open models retrain on checked results, and replace the base only when they beat it.

ideas.name: Reviewing open-source repos at scale
ideas.line: Every repo gets the same questions, each answered with evidence and pinned to an exact commit.

ideas.name: Composing verified code without rewriting it
ideas.line: Agents put tested pieces of code together instead of writing the same code again.

ideas.name: Research before building
ideas.line: Before anything new is built, find what already exists and compare the alternatives.

ideas.name: Turning every bug and annoyance into a fix
ideas.line: Anything someone notices becomes a recorded finding, fixed by one worker and checked by another.

ideas.name: Customer-support knowledge that stays current
ideas.line: Each answer names the product version it's true for, and old answers get flagged before they mislead.

ideas.name: Literature review for research teams
ideas.line: New papers are screened against the team's question, and every claim keeps its source.

ideas.name: Course and lesson building for teachers
ideas.line: Lessons, quizzes and rubrics are drafted to a standard, and a teacher reviews every one.

ideas.name: Disaster-relief volunteer coordination
ideas.line: Shift plans and checklists are ready fast, and people keep every safety decision.

ideas.name: Grant writing and reporting for nonprofits
ideas.line: Drafts follow each funder's rules, and a person signs and submits them.

ideas.name: Compliance checklists that cite the rule in force
ideas.line: Every checklist line points to its rule and the date that rule applies from.

ideas.name: Data pipelines that are checked step by step
ideas.line: Each step is a verb with its own check, so bad data stops where it starts.

yours.name: Your system
yours.line: Any work can be nouns and verbs. Name the things it reuses and the jobs it repeats, and any agent can pick them up.
